summary: Nixxy, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 30, 2026, reporting the termination of a binding Letter of Intent with Tachyon 9 Corporation, originally dated June 15, 2026. The company ended the agreement to pursue other business opportunities; no early termination penalties were incurred. Concurrently, Nixxy issued a press release announcing a strategic AI infrastructure platform initiative, including negotiations with the developer of the Nakota project to acquire the property and a potential long-term global definitive agreement for the entire project. The filing is primarily a termination disclosure with forward-looking statements. What to watch: the new Nakota acquisition negotiations and their terms, which could signal a shift in strategic direction following the LOI termination.
